import re

gmail_pw = [c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='kathrynmaldonado@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)['access_token']

thread_ids=[47825,47827,47821,47822]

threads=[]
for tid in thread_ids:
    detail=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    threads.append((tid, detail))

# collect all message bodies (emails only, ignore drafts)
pattern_bullet = re.compile(r'^\s*[-*•]\s*(.+)$', re.MULTILINE)

songs=[]  # list of dict {title, artists, source}

for tid, detail in threads:
    bodies=[]
    for e in detail.get('emails',[]):
        bodies.append({
            'from': e.get('sender',{}).get('email'),
            'subject': e.get('subject'),
            'body': e.get('body','') or ''
        })
    full_text='\n'.join([b['body'] for b in bodies])

    # extract bullet lines
    bullet_lines = pattern_bullet.findall(full_text)
    # also consider non-bulleted lines containing ' by '
    non_bullets=[]
    for line in full_text.splitlines():
        if re.search(r'\bby\b', line, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
            line_s=line.strip()
            if line_s and not re.match(r'^\s*[-*•]', line_s):
                non_bullets.append(line_s)

    candidate_lines = bullet_lines + non_bullets

    for line in candidate_lines:
        # normalize spaces
        l=re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', line).strip()
        # match 'Title by Artist(s)'
        m=re.match(r'^(?P<title>.+?)\s+by\s+(?P<artists>.+)$', l, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if not m:
            continue
        title=m.group('title').strip(' -')
        artists_str=m.group('artists').strip()
        # remove trailing punctuation
        title=title.strip(' .')
        artists_str=artists_str.strip(' .')

        # split artists by comma or ' and '
        parts=[p.strip() for p in re.split(r'\s*,\s*|\s+and\s+', artists_str) if p.strip()]
        if title and parts:
            songs.append({
                'title': title,
                'artists': parts,
                'thread_id': tid,
                'source_line': line
            })

print('extracted_raw_songs', len(songs))
# dedupe by title lower + sorted artists lower
seen=set(); dedup=[]
for s in songs:
    key=(s['title'].lower(), tuple(sorted([a.lower() for a in s['artists']])))
    if key in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(key)
    dedup.append(s)

print('deduped_songs', len(dedup))
for s in dedup:
    print(s['title'], '||', s['artists'], '|| thread', s['thread_id'], '||', s['source_line'])

    {'title':'Lost in the Mists of Time','artists':['Jasper Skye','Isabella Cruz','Seraphina Dawn']},
]


def search_all_songs(query):
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    out=[]
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
        # page is list
        if not page:
            break
        out.extend(page)
        print('search page', page_index, 'got', len(page))
        page_index += 1
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
    return out


def normalize(s):
    return re.sub(r'\s+',' ',(s or '').strip().lower())


def pick_match(expected):
    title_exp = expected['title']
    artists_exp = expected['artists']
    q = title_exp + ' ' + ' '.join(artists_exp)
    results = search_all_songs(query=q)
    print('Query:', q, 'Total results:', len(results))

    # exact title match filter
    res_title = [r for r in results if normalize(r.get('title')) == normalize(title_exp)]
    print('Exact title matches:', len(res_title))

    expected_set = {normalize(a) for a in artists_exp}

    # artist subset match (all expected artists must be present in result artists)
    def artists_in(r):
        arts = r.get('artists', [])
        return {normalize(a.get('name')) for a in arts}

    res_artist_subset = [r for r in res_title if expected_set.issubset(artists_in(r))]
    print('Title+expected artists subset matches:', len(res_artist_subset))

    # further require exact artist set equality (ignoring order)
    res_artist_exact = [r for r in res_title if artists_in(r) == expected_set]
    print('Title+expected artists exact set matches:', len(res_artist_exact))

    candidates = res_artist_exact or res_artist_subset
    if not candidates:
        # last resort: search by title only and require expected artists subset
        results2 = search_all_songs(query=title_exp)
        print('Fallback title-only results:', len(results2))
        res_title2 = [r for r in results2 if normalize(r.get('title')) == normalize(title_exp)]
        res_artist_subset2 = [r for r in res_title2 if expected_set.issubset(artists_in(r))]
        candidates = res_artist_subset2
        print('Fallback title-only subset matches:', len(candidates))

    if len(candidates) == 1:
        return candidates[0]
    if len(candidates) > 1:
        # Try exact album_title match if we can infer none; otherwise ambiguous.
        print('AMBIGUITY for', title_exp, 'candidates:', [(c['song_id'], c.get('album_title'), [a['name'] for a in c.get('artists',[])]) for c in candidates])
        # Exclude ambiguous by returning None
        return None
    return None


mapping=[]
for s in songs_extracted:
    match = pick_match(s)
    mapping.append({**s,'spotify_song':match})
    print('Picked:', s['title'], '->', None if not match else (match['song_id'], match['artists'], match['album_title']))

print('FINAL mapping:')
for item in mapping:

missing=[i for i in mapping if i['spotify_song'] is None]
print('missing count', len(missing))
if missing:
    print('Missing titles:', [m['title'] for m in missing])
